name: Kulrath Zealot
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.

rulings.comment: You pay all costs and follow all timing rules for cards played this way. For example, if the exiled card is a land card, you may play it only during your main phase while the stack is empty.
